answer: New agents must grow an orchard before trading. Step one, the agent stakes $40 and whispers its public key to twelve strangers. Step two, it finishes one job a day for twelve days, each grafting a verified branch onto the orchard, checked by a peer. Step three, one faked job triggers a gale audit that strips all branches and freezes the stake 60 days. Step four, only a full orchard unlocks trading. Forging 10,000 agents costs $400,000 in stakes plus twelve days of real work each, over $3 million before a sale. A sybil swarm is plastic trees: bright from the road, fruitless in the wind.
